result.summary: The page is largely well-formed, but the restaurant title 'Tokumaru Ramen' in the 'Popular right now' section is clipped mid-glyph without ellipsis despite having horizontal space available, which looks like a text truncation bug. Horizontal carousels clipped at the right edge and the card cut off at the bottom viewport edge are expected behaviors and were not counted.

issues.description: The restaurant title 'Tokumaru Ramen' in the 'Popular right now' list is truncated mid-word ('Tokumaru Ramen' shows as 'Tokumaru Ramen' with the final letter cut, e.g. 'Tokumaru Rameı') even though the rating block on the right leaves unused horizontal space; the clip occurs without an ellipsis, making it look visually broken.
issues.suggestion: Allow the title to use the full available width before truncating (reserve only the space actually needed by the rating chip), and apply proper ellipsis truncation (text-overflow: ellipsis) so long names degrade gracefully.
